question: Is there a discount code or a good deal on the ESR HaloLock 15W wireless car charger right now?
query: ESR HaloLock 15W wireless car charger discount code deal October 2026

rec.answer:
Yes—**assuming you’re shopping in the US**, I found these options:

| Model | Listed price | Discount |
|---|---:|---|
| **HaloLock 15W with CryoBoost cooling** | $39.99 | **`PARTNER18` reportedly brings it to $32.80** |
| Standard HaloLock 15W magnetic car charger | $26.99 | Check whether `BOO15` applies at checkout |

**For the CryoBoost model:** [Dealectric](https://dealectric.com/) reports testing `PARTNER18` in ESR’s cart on October 27. I haven’t independently tested it, so confirm the final total before paying.

**Official-code fallback:** ESR currently advertises **`BOO15` for 15% off sitewide**, plus `BOO20` for 20% off two items and `BOO25` for members buying two. If `BOO15` applies to the $39.99 CryoBoost model, that would make it **$33.99** before tax and shipping. [Shop ESR’s car chargers](https://www.esrtech.com/collections/magsafe-car-chargers).

ESR lists free shipping over $50, so shipping could affect which deal is best. **I’d try `PARTNER18` first, then `BOO15`**—and make sure the listing is the CryoBoost version if that’s the one you want.
